Name: Mobile Phone - Huniepop 1 Themes
Author: ColoredPerson
Description:
WORKS WITH MOBILE PHONE CONTINUED by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/25104754]JoXW[/url]
This is an extension to the Mobile Phone mod made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]. This mod adds Huniepop Borders, Backgrounds and Ringtones to your Mobile Phone App.

Version 1.0 contains:
25 backgrounds
5 borders
3 ringtones

I recommend to change the config of the Mobile Phone mod (either with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] or within config.json)﻿:
change Min Rings -> 1
change Max Rings -> 1


This is because the ringtones I'm using are longer than the original "ring". Changing these configs make the ringtones will not be played multiple times.


Everything used is from the Huniepop series and all art is therefore made by the original creator of Huniepop.
